selection.limitations: Rechecked on 2026-11-12: 498 active identities have fresh Nexon Open API evidence and one has freshly checked published-ranking evidence. 더스크바운드 이지스 그리브 retains valid November 5 evidence because fresh API and ranking observations were empty. Expired-evidence 더스크바운드 이지스 가드(여성용) moves to the archive with its original identity; fresh current-listing evidence returns 소울 리버레이트 해머 to discovery. Empty observations do not establish retirement. observedFrom/To retain the original ranking observation interval; current API observations use each item's verifiedAt. Labanyu samples the one-hour Nexon API by exact item name and excludes some item types.
